prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create an original wide 3:1 panoramic background illustration for a cosy Transylvanian bistro game. DO NOT PUT ANY TEXT, LETTERING, NUMBERS OR SIGNS anywhere in the picture. It is an entirely invented place, not an existing establishment or game location. Hand-painted gouache with delicate colored pencil edges, an accomplished illustrated travel-journal feel, believable proportions and architectural perspective. Do not resemble glossy mobile-game art.

Subject: the back wall of a small Saxon village bistro front room at blue hour, on the evening before it reopens, seen straight on from a seat at a table in the middle of the room, at seated eye level. The viewer's own table is not visible. The room is tidy but tired and not yet restored: quiet and slightly mysterious, but safe and inviting. Thick cream limewashed walls with faint scuffs, dark exposed wooden ceiling beams with a few bunches of dried herbs, and a teal glazed tile stove left of centre glowing softly through its small fire door; the stove is the main warm light. Two amber hanging lamps hang from the beams but are unlit. One large round leaded window right of centre has dusty, cloudy panes, through which a plum-blue dusk sky, layered Carpathian hills, a village church spire and three small bats are still visible. Its deep wooden windowsill is empty. On the back wall: a pair of bare iron shelf brackets with no shelf on them yet; a blank weathered wooden board with no writing, leaning against the wall; copper cooking vessels hanging on pegs, dulled; a stack of chairs under a pale dust sheet at the far left edge; one lit candle on a ledge; a folded rust and ivory embroidered runner with invented simple botanical motifs.

Composition for an interface strip: keep the stove and the round window inside the central 70% of the width, so the image can be cropped narrower. The bottom 30% of the image is a calm, low-detail zone: a plain wooden wainscot and the top edge of a long bare back counter at mid-distance, with no objects, chairs, food or bright highlights, because head-and-shoulders figures and small speech bubbles will be placed over it. Nothing important touches the bottom edge.

Light: warm stove and candle glow on the left and centre, cool plum-blue evening light from the window on the right; balanced and readable, not dark or gloomy. No people, no cats, no animals indoors, no food, no vampires, no pumpkin theme, no skulls, no horror cobwebs, no broken glass, no movie references, no logos, no writing, no frame, no vignette, no UI. Render the whole image fully finished.

Use case: texture. Create an original seamless tileable square texture for a cosy Transylvanian bistro game. DO NOT PUT ANY TEXT, NUMBERS OR SYMBOLS in the image. Strict top-down orthographic view of the surface of an old farmhouse kitchen table: five or six wide wooden planks running horizontally from edge to edge, warm chestnut and walnut brown with subtle honey highlights, hand-painted gouache with delicate colored pencil grain lines, in a mature, cosy European storybook illustration style. Keep it low contrast and evenly lit across the whole image: no strong knots, cracks, nail heads, glossy highlights, cast shadows, perspective or vignette, because a grid of cream tiles will sit on top of it and must stay readable. Matte finish. No objects, no cloth, no crumbs, no stains. The texture must tile seamlessly on all four edges: the plank seams and the grain continue across the left and right borders and across the top and bottom borders.

Create an original character atlas for a cosy Transylvanian bistro game: ONE square image divided into a regular 2 by 2 grid of four equal square cells, with a true transparent background (no checkerboard, no colored matte, no grid lines). Each cell holds exactly one head-and-shoulders portrait of a fictional, everyday Romanian village neighbour who works at a small bistro. They are invented people, not copies of anyone real or famous. Hand-painted gouache with delicate colored pencil edges, an accomplished illustrated travel-journal feel, natural proportions, warm and dignified, never a caricature or a costume-party joke. Consistent gentle warm lamplight from the upper left on all four.

Framing, the same in every cell: the figure faces the viewer, very slightly turned, head and full natural shoulders and upper arms, cut STRAIGHT ACROSS horizontally at mid-chest at about 92% of the cell height, with the shoulders and upper arms at their full natural width (about 80 to 88% of the cell width) right down to that straight cut. NO oval vignette, NO rounded, tapered or faded bottom, NO cameo shape: the body simply continues and is cut by a level horizontal edge, as if the person stands behind a counter. Eyes at about 36% of the cell height. Transparent space above the head and on both sides; nothing crosses into another cell; no shadow on the background.

Dress: working Romanian village folk clothing, clearly recognisable as Romanian at a glance but practical for bistro work, clean and well kept: white linen ie blouses or shirts with cross-stitch embroidery in traditional red and black geometric and floral motifs, sheepskin or felt vests (bondita) with embroidered edges, woven aprons. Embroidery is invented, simple and folk-geometric. No modern logos, no text.

Top left, Mara, the bistro owner, about 40: light warm complexion, loose wavy dark brown hair tied back under a patterned red and black headscarf (basma) knotted at the nape, a white ie blouse with red cross-stitch bands on the shoulders, a forest-green woven apron, a calm practical smile.
Top right, Ilie, the baker, about 70: light complexion, silver hair and a full silver moustache, round wire glasses, a black lambskin caciula hat, a white linen shirt with black stitching at the collar, a brown sheepskin vest with embroidered edges, a little flour on the vest, a kind grandfatherly smile.
Bottom left, Eszter, the potter, about 35: light complexion, short dark auburn bob, a Transylvanian folk blouse with black and red stitching at the collar and cuffs, a dark felt vest, a few dry clay marks on one sleeve, a warm direct smile.
Bottom right, Sorin, the young helper, about 25: light neutral complexion, short slightly wavy chestnut hair, clean-shaven, a white linen shirt with sleeves rolled up and red stitching on the placket, a dark embroidered felt vest, a woven red and black belt just visible at the cut, a cheerful open smile.

Naturally varied individual faces and builds. No text, names, numbers, logos, frames, borders, props, food, animals or background scenery. Preserve alpha transparency.
prompts.disposition: The user accepted Mara and Ilie; superseded to dress Eszter in Szekely folk dress, to make Sorin's face painterly, and to ask for fully opaque figures.
